verdict.rationale: The only condition-based automation in the evidence is escalation policies: rules based on time, team availability and incident origin that keep re-alerting people until an incident is acknowledged. That covers a narrow, notification-only slice of the story, and the automated post-mortem is an AI feature rather than a configurable workflow. missing for 10: a general condition-based workflow engine, automated incident field/status changes, configurable stakeholder update and reminder actions triggered by incident events, and independent corroboration.
